profile.name: HP 8116A 波形发生器
profile.description: HP 8116A 是一台最高约 50 MHz 的台式波形/函数信号发生器，可输出正弦波、三角波、方波和直流等信号，并可调节频率、幅度与直流偏置。它常用于电子电路测试、仪器联调和实验室中的激励信号产生。
profile.description_en: The HP 8116A is a benchtop waveform/function generator with output frequencies up to about 50 MHz. It can generate sine, triangle, square, and DC signals, with adjustable frequency, amplitude, and DC offset. It is commonly used in electronics testing, instrument setup, and laboratory signal stimulation.
